title: Answer
description:
He went out without knowing the place, and he knew who had spoken.

He was promised a land, and he waited for a city with foundations whose builder and maker is God. The city does not cancel the land. It is what he was waiting for beyond the land in hand.

What was dead was given life, because she judged Him faithful who had promised.

They all died in faith, not having received the promises, having seen them afar off, and confessing that they were strangers. Better means a heavenly country, even though a land had already been promised.

He offered the son through whom the promise had been spoken, accounting that God was able to raise him from the dead. He received him back in a figure, the living return.

Blessings spoken over sons were faith because they named a future not yet seen.

Bones carried out of the land of bondage were faith that the promise could not be buried there.
